featured.title: Quantum Framework for Simulating Linear PDEs with Robin Boundary Conditions
featured.authors: Nikita Guseynov, Xiajie Huang, Nana Liu
featured.summary: Theorem 3/4 are mapped to explicit Lean scope. The fixed N=8 Robin benchmark closes source normal forms, an exact XOR four-slot winner, and same-tier resource comparisons; the arbitrary-width primitive compiler remains a separate frontier.

queue.title: Transformation of quantum states using uniformly controlled rotations
queue.authors: Mikko Möttönen, Juha J. Vartiainen, Ville Bergholm, Martti M. Salomaa
queue.formalized: Exact dense two-qubit target, unitary completion, state-action certificate, and a five-gate binary-tree resource transcript.
queue.remaining: General n-qubit state-to-state synthesis, phase layer, analytic rotation-angle construction, and the paper-wide CNOT/one-qubit rotation count theorem.

queue.title: Creating superpositions that correspond to efficiently integrable probability distributions
queue.formalized: Exact product-distribution benchmark and a Lean same-target theorem showing the factorized two-rotation route strictly beats a generic five-gate tree transcript.
queue.remaining: The general efficiently-integrable recursive probability-loading theorem and an end-to-end arithmetic/integration oracle compiler.

queue.title: Circuit Complexity of Sparse Quantum State Preparation
queue.formalized: An exact d=3 three-qubit sparse target, unitary completion, and a Lean resource theorem showing zero-branch pruning strictly beats the frozen dense-tree transcript.
queue.remaining: The asymptotic sparse synthesis constructions, ancilla/depth tradeoffs, and the matching circuit-size lower bounds.

queue.title: Trading T gates for dirty qubits in state preparation and unitary synthesis
queue.authors: Guang Hao Low, Vadym Kliuchnikov, Luke Schaeffer
queue.formalized: A machine-checked SelectSwap clean-qubit T-count arithmetic row and a fixed lambda=4 versus lambda=1 tradeoff example.
queue.remaining: Approximate Clifford+T state preparation, coherent lookup/SelectSwap semantics, dirty-qubit correctness, error accounting, and the full asymptotic optimality theorem.

queue.title: Asymptotically Optimal Circuit Depth for Quantum State Preparation and General Unitary Synthesis
queue.authors: Xiaoming Sun, Guojing Tian, Shuai Yang, Pei Yuan, Shengyu Zhang
queue.remaining: The ancilla-sensitive state-preparation construction, depth/size upper bounds, and the matching optimal-depth statements across the claimed parameter regimes.

queue.title: Quantum-state preparation with universal gate decompositions
queue.remaining: Universal state-preparation decomposition and its CNOT/depth counts, including the four-qubit benchmark.

queue.title: Synthesis of Quantum Logic Circuits
queue.authors: Vivek V. Shende, Stephen S. Bullock, Igor L. Markov
queue.formalized: The local uniformly-controlled-RY compiler provides a related reusable primitive, but this paper is not claimed reproduced.
queue.remaining: Paper-faithful quantum-multiplexor/state-initialization synthesis, its CNOT complexity theorem, and the lower-bound comparison.
